preconditions.description: Number of vertices and edges within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i and 1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has valid vertices and weight within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(set((u_i, v_i) for u_i, v_i, _ in edges)) == m
all(u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i, _ in edges)

postconditions.description: Minimum number of operations is non-negative.
The returned value is the minimum number of operations required to unify the MST.
